title: COP31 spotlight on the Pacific Resilience Facility
summary: Australia has focused global attention on the Pacific at the world’s biggest climate conference, COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye.Prime Minister Anthony Albanese highlighted the imminent threat of climate change in the Pacific and called for global support for the Pacific Resilience Facility, a Pacific-owned and led financing institution.
